title: flaky: DatasetWidget.chartBucketIdentity pins the same overshooting drawer-render count the drillTitleLabel fix removed — the sweep was file-scoped
body:
Observed on an unrelated PR (#4717 — data-objectstack test-only change). `Test (shard 2/4)` went red on:

```
FAIL  dom  packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DatasetWidget.chartBucketIdentity.test.tsx
AssertionError: expected 2 to be 1 // Object.is equality
 ❯ packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DatasetWidget.chartBucketIdentity.test.tsx:151:53
```

Job: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/31894060004/job/95034512295 (head `820b4d716` — a PR touching only `packages/data-objectstack`; the `dom` project runs `isolate: true`, so no cross-file mechanism exists, same causality argument as the earlier sibling card).

## Same defect class, second file

This is the exact overshoot profile fixed in `DatasetWidget.drillTitleLabel.test.tsx` by PR #4708: a `waitFor` pinning a cumulative drawer-render recording to exactly `1`, which a late `setMeta` re-render pushes to `2` with no possible recovery (the recording only grows). That fix's sweep was deliberately file-scoped; `chartBucketIdentity.test.tsx` (landed with the chart-bucket identity work) shares the recording-array idiom and is now the second file to red-light an unrelated PR with it.

## Direction (the precedent is one merge old)

Apply PR #4708's exact treatment to this file: relax the exact-count pin to at-least-once, keep the content assertions (which bucket/title the drawer got) as the substantive check, and sweep **all remaining `plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__` files** for the `drawerProps.length).toBe(1)` idiom this time — two file-scoped fixes in one day says the class outlives any single file. Each site kept as exact-count needs a stated causal reason, per the #4708 body's pattern.

## Triage

`pm:queue`: S, precedent PR #4708 (merged today) is the template. Failed jobs on the observing PR re-queued as mitigation.

Provenance: PM review of #4717's shard-2 red, session `session_01RnQd8iMMUwXQEV1crFmQiQ`. Filed unassigned.
